prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a botanically correct realistic full-color photograph cutout of ONE Monstera deliciosa leaf and its petiole for a visual recognition game. Landscape 4:3 PNG, truly transparent background with actual alpha=0, no opaque or painted background. Crucial orientation and anatomy: the single pointed leaf tip faces UP at 12 o'clock. The wide rounded heart-shaped BASE with TWO rounded basal lobes faces DOWN at 6 o'clock. The petiole emerges from the deep basal notch BETWEEN these two lower lobes, and extends downward. The central midrib runs upward from that basal attachment to the single pointed apex at the top. Never attach a stalk to the pointed apex. Leaf has several natural side splits and a few true fenestration holes in the green blade, all holes genuinely transparent. Flat frontal face view, natural dark green leaf textures, neutral studio lighting, no veins outside the leaf, no additional leaves or objects. Keep entire leaf and entire stalk wholly inside central 65% of frame with ample transparent margins on ALL sides, no edge cropping. Render the color leaf, not a black silhouette. No text, no watermark, no frame, no checkerboard, no ground or cast shadow.

review.note: Corrected Monstera leaf has pointed apex above, rounded basal lobes below and petiole joining between those basal lobes. Full stalk and leaf outline are visible.
